narrative:
From the very beginning, we knew our hearts had found something truly special. What began as a mutual passion for chicken wings and ramen soon grew into a love beyond anything we could have imagined.

A journey filled with endless laughter, unforgettable adventures, quiet moments of comfort, and countless beautiful memories. Every day together has been a reminder that the greatest love stories are written one precious moment at a time, and ours is only just beginning.
